subject: [PATCH v2] statx: don't leak STATX_ATTR_CHANGE_MONOTONIC in stx_attributes_mask

reviews.author: Christoph Hellwig
reviews.summary: Identified the bug and suggested introducing a new mask constant to fix it. The patch looks good and has been accepted with a positive review.
reviews.raw_body:
On Tue, Nov 03, 2026 at 07:04:00AM -0500, Jeff Layton wrote:
> STATX_ATTR_CHANGE_MONOTONIC is kernel-internal. cp_statx() strips it
> from stx_attributes but copies attributes_mask verbatim, so it leaks to
> userland on filesystems that advertise it (nfs, ceph), e.g.
> stx_attributes_mask = 0x8000000000303000 on NFS.
> 
> Add a new mask constant and apply it to both fields.

Looks good:

Reviewed-by: Christoph Hellwig <hch@lst.de>

2026-11-03.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the statx system call where kernel-internal attribute STATX_ATTR_CHANGE_MONOTONIC is leaked to userland on filesystems that advertise it. The fix involves introducing a new mask constant and applying it to both stx_attributes and stx_attributes_mask.
